Sipke Ernst - Attacking Chess: Know When to Strike
rubriker._rss_content: GM Sipke Ernst explains how to recognize when an attack is truly justified, focusing on factors such as development, king safety, open lines and central control. Through successful and failed examples, he shows when to strike, when to build pressure, and when a quieter or prophylactic move is the stronger choice.

rubriker.title: KazChess Masters: Mamedov and Makhnev set the pace in Almaty
rubriker._rss_content: Kazakh grandmasters Edgar Mamedov (pictured) and Denis Makhnev share the lead at the KazChess Masters in Almaty after three rounds, both with 2½ points. Mamedov, aged 16, started with two consecutive wins, while Makhnev caught up by defeating Aram Hakobyan in round three. Three of the five international participants - Daniil Dubov, Shamsiddin Vokhidov and Denis Lazavik - are half a point behind the leading duo. | Photo: Nils Rohde / ChessBase

rubriker.title: Clutch Chess: Champions Showdown - Live!
rubriker._rss_content: Clutch Chess: Champions Showdown is a high-profile rapid tournament gathering four elite competitors. Javokhir Sindarov, who is set to challenge Gukesh Dommaraju for the World Championship title next month, joins Fabiano Caruana, Hikaru Nakamura and Praggnanandhaa Rameshbabu in a three-day battle. The competition runs from 27 to 29 October and follows a "clutch" structure of three double round-robins, where results become progressively more valuable with each round-robin. | Follow the action live starting at 18.00 CET (13.00 ET, 22.30 IST) | Photo: Crystal Fuller

rubriker.title: Dragons of the Olympiad 2026 - The Monthly Dragon
rubriker._rss_content: In this Olympiad special of the Monthly Dragon, Chris Ward looks at five Dragon games from a wide range of rating levels and shows just how successful the opening was in Samarkand. The examples highlight typical Dragon themes such as pressure on the c file, the strength of the dark squared bishop, exchange sacrifices, tactical ideas around the queenside and the importance of knowing the right plans once the opening theory ends. Chris also examines several instructive mistakes, showing how quickly a position can collapse when White loses track of key Dragon motifs. | Photo: John Upham

rubriker.title: A los 11 años, Shogdzhiev queda a una norma del título de Gran Maestro
rubriker._rss_content: Roman Shogdzhiev, de 11 años, consiguió su segunda norma de Gran Maestro tras sumar 6 puntos en 9 partidas en la Superliga de Serbia, donde representó al Partizan de Belgrado. El joven ruso ganó 26 puntos de Elo y ahora necesita una norma más para obtener el título de GM. A falta de ocho meses para que venza el plazo para superar el récord de precocidad de Abhimanyu Mishra, Shogdzhiev tiene grandes posibilidades de convertirse en el GM más joven de la historia. | Foto: Eteri Kublashvili
